rows.faith_note: All factual claims trace to the source material. The prepayment-meter recovery requirement (27.9), payment-difficulty services (27.5-27.8A), winter/vulnerability protections (27.10-27.11A), and the publish/inform statement obligation (27.12) are all in Extract 2. The proportionality-of-debt-recovery/warrant points come from Condition 28 (28.14-28.15), and the 8 November 2023 text-change plus 1 August 2025 consolidation dates match the temporal facts. The phrase about involuntary prepayment meters being installed 'as an alternative to disconnection' is a mild contextual framing consistent with the licence's prepayment-meter debt-recovery scheme rather than an unsupported factual assertion.

All claims trace to the source material. Condition 26 obligations (establish/maintain register, promote, identify during interactions, record Minimum Details, definitions of Personal Characteristics, share via Relevant Industry Mechanisms, data protection compliance) match Extract 1. The Condition 28 claim about checking the PSR before involuntary prepayment meter installation (28.7(e)) and Site Welfare Visits identifying vulnerabilities matches Extract 2, and the effective version/date (1 August 2025, in force since 8 November 2023) matches the temporal facts.

All factual claims trace to the source material. The domestic end-of-fixed-term Notice requirements and content match Condition 31I (31I.1(c), 31I.2, 31I.6, 31I.7). Default tariff/continued supply claims match 22C.7-22C.8. Renewal requirements match 22C.5. The Micro Business 60-day and Statement of Renewal Terms details match 7A.8 and 7A.6, and the bill information matches 7A.10A-10B. The SLC 23.2 exception note matches 23.2A. No unsupported facts were asserted.

All claims trace to Condition 21BA in Extract 3: the 12-month back-billing limit, the four exceptions, and the contract terms requirements. The version/as-of statements match the source material. No unsupported facts.

The answer accurately reflects Condition 14A: the five Working Day switching timescale, the exceptions in 14A.3, completion within five Working Days of the condition ceasing, the definition of Relevant Date, the systems-improvement obligation (next Working Day for domestic, second Working Day for non-domestic), and the cooperation duty. It correctly notes that Guaranteed Standards compensation amounts are not set out in the retrieved extracts, which is a faithful decline rather than an unsupported claim. No hallucinated facts are present.
All claims trace to Condition 21BA extract: the 12-month limit (21BA.1), the four exceptions (21BA.2), and contract terms requirements (21BA.3-21BA.5). No unsupported facts asserted.
